description: This Java source file defines the PersistedServiceJob class, which extends GenericServiceJob and manages scheduled, persistently stored jobs within the OFBiz framework. It handles job creation, queuing, execution, recurrence scheduling, retries, and status updates, utilizing entity engine persistence and calendar utilities.

classes.name: PersistedServiceJob
classes.description: Manages persistent scheduled service jobs with recurrence, retries, and status updates within the OFBiz framework, extending GenericServiceJob.

methods.name: PersistedServiceJob
methods.description: Constructor initializing a PersistedServiceJob instance with scheduling and retry parameters based on job values from the entity store.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Queues the job for execution by updating status and start time, verifying job instance identity.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the job, sets start time and status, handles recurrence info, and schedules next recurrence if applicable.

methods.name: createRecurrence
methods.description: Creates a new job recurrence at the specified next time if it is after the current start time.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks the job as finished, updates status and result message, storing the final state.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Handles job failure, potentially reschedules for retries, and updates job status accordingly.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service associated with the job.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves the execution context for the job, including runtime data and user login info.

methods.name: getRetries
methods.description: Counts the number of retries for the current job session based on related failed jobs.

methods.name: canRetry
methods.description: Determines if the job is eligible for retry based on max retry constraints.

methods.name: getRecurrenceInfo
methods.description: Fetches recurrence information associated with the job, if any.

methods.name: deQueue
methods.description: Removes the job from the queue, resetting its state and scheduled times.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the job as a Date object.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the job, defaulting if not explicitly set.
